summary_1line: Bhima asks Hanuman about his former giant form, leading Hanuman to explain the changing ages (yugas) and the gradual decline of virtue over time.

image_candidates.scene_text: Bhima bows respectfully before the mighty monkey-chief Hanuman in a forest clearing while asking to see the colossal form that once leapt across the ocean.
Hanuman smiling gently as he explains the passing ages, with symbolic visions of four yugas unfolding behind him.
A cosmic tableau showing the four yugas—white, red, yellow, and black—each fading into the next as virtue diminishes.
